corrections.value: Mountain weather is unpredictable; even in summer, visitors are advised to bring warm clothes for summits.
corrections.quote: Prévoyez de bonnes chaussures de marche, de l'eau en quantité suffisante et des vêtements chauds. De cette façon, vous pourrez étirer le plaisir au sommet!
corrections.reason: Source explicitly advises warm clothing for the summit specifically to allow for longer stays.

corrections.value: Purchase the required daily access through Sépaq and check the park’s current access and parking conditions before departure. An advance purchase should not be treated as a guarantee that every trail or sector will be accessible.
corrections.quote: Il est possible que l'accès à un secteur, à un sentier ou à une activité vous soit malheureusement refusé si un stationnement est plein, ou encore, si la capacité d'accueil maximale établie de ce secteur est atteinte.
corrections.reason: The source generalizes the capacity issue to all sectors and parking lots, not just Mont-du-Lac-des-Cygnes.

summary: Grands-Jardins National Park is accurately described as a taiga/tundra landscape within the Charlevoix Biosphere Reserve. Factual support for the Mont-du-Lac-des-Cygnes views, Le Pioui ridges, and Malbaie River fishing is strong. Corrections were made to emphasize that parking capacity issues affect all sectors, and that warm clothing is specifically recommended for summit visits.
